description:
NixOS has vm-integration.nix for testing the host module. No equivalent exists for darwin.nix.

Needed:
- Nix evaluation test that verifies darwin.nix produces correct config
- Test that config-gen.nix handles both platforms correctly
- Verify environment.etc entries are generated properly
- Test activation script produces correct directory structure
- Consider using nix-darwin's test framework if available
title: Add nix-darwin module evaluation tests
